data.text: Pizza Co. generates $50M of baseline free cash flow on $100M of EBITDA. Total debt is $400M, with a 4.0x leverage ratio and 5.0x interest coverage.
The agreement permits leverage up to 5.00x and requires at least 2.00x interest coverage. Pizza Co. passes both tests at baseline.
The business has ample cash generation and significant covenant headroom. I recommend lending.
Debt is meaningful, but the current coverage cushion and cash balance offset the risk.
Both covenants pass with room to spare. The committee recommends lending.
Lend — Pizza Co. passes both loan rules at baseline.
